13-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (93-bet) - O'QISh va LUG'AT.

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K yorliqda oq '13', chapida 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN (och sariq fon):
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading'.
4) 'Read the text and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.' 1 What happened in Hamamatsu about 430 years ago? 2 What preparations for the festival does the writer mention? 3 What is the aim of the kite battles? 4 What do the kite teams wear? 5 What other things do people do while the kites are flying? 6 What did the writer do on the last evening? 7 How did the writer feel at the end of the festival?
   OQ QUTI, sarlavha 'The Kite Battles', surat D (katta qizil varrak):
   1-xatboshi: 'I'll never forget my visit to the Japanese city of Hamamatsu. I decided to go at the beginning of May, when the local people have their kite festival. Every year, between 3rd and 5th May, the local people fly colourful kites to bring their children good health, STRENGTH and COURAGE. On the way there I read a little about the history of the Hamamatsu Kite Festival. Apparently, it all started about 430 years ago, when the LORD of the REGION sent a HUGE kite into the sky with his child's name on it.'
   2: 'When I arrived there, a few days before the beginning of the festival, I was amazed at the PREPARATIONS involved. Some people were making ENORMOUS kites, while others were busy decorating brightly-coloured floats. Everywhere I went I could smell cakes and sweets cooking, ready for the big festival. I couldn't wait to try them!'
   3: 'On the first day of the festival, the sky was filled with huge, colourful kites. I was so excited that I couldn't take my eyes off the sky. "The AIM of the battle," explained an old man, "is not to win a prize, but for the teams to show off their skills by knocking the other teams' kites out of the sky." He also told me that each team was flying a kite for a family who had recently had their first child. I NOTICED that every team had different costumes, which were embroidered with ELABORATE DESIGNS to match the ones on their kites. They wore scarves around their heads and they had to wear gloves to protect their hands from the kite STRINGS. The kite TEAMS were mostly men, but hundreds of women and children had come to watch the EVENT. The atmosphere was fantastic, and all around me people kept waving flags, banging drums, playing trumpets and blowing whistles. At the same time, the teams were FURIOUSLY TUGGING their OPPONENTS' kites to the ground. I couldn't help admiring them for putting on such a STUNNING SHOW.'
   4: 'On the last evening of the festival, I really enjoyed walking around the city centre and watching the floats. People had put an incredible amount of work into making them and they were really beautiful. It made me feel sad to think that I would leave for Tokyo the next day, but I knew that the MEMORIES of the kite festival would stay with me forever.'

MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahriga
tashrifimni hech qachon unutmayman.
May boshida borishga qaror qildim -
mahalliy odamlar varrak festivalini
o'tkazadigan vaqt. Har yili 3-5 may
oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar
bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat
keltirish uchun rangli varraklar
uchiradi. Yo'lda Hamamatsu varrak
festivali tarixi haqida biroz
o'qidim. Aftidan, hammasi taxminan
430 yil oldin, viloyat hukmdori
bolasining ismi yozilgan ulkan
varrakni osmonga uchirganida
boshlangan.

2) U yerga festival boshlanishidan
bir necha kun oldin kelganimda,
tayyorgarliklardan hayratda qoldim.
Ba'zi odamlar ulkan varraklar
yasardi, boshqalar yorqin rangli
aravalarni bezash bilan band edi.
Qayerga bormay, katta festival uchun
tayyorlanayotgan tort va shirinliklar
hidini sezardim. Ularni tatib
ko'rishga sabrim chidamasdi!

3) Festivalning birinchi kuni osmon
ulkan rangli varraklar bilan to'ldi.
Shunchalik hayajonlandimki, osmondan
ko'z uzolmasdim. "Jangning maqsadi, -
deb tushuntirdi bir chol, - sovrin
yutish emas, balki jamoalar boshqa
jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib
tushirib, mahoratini ko'rsatishi." U
menga har bir jamoa yaqinda birinchi
farzand ko'rgan oila uchun varrak
uchirayotganini ham aytdi. Har bir
jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini
payqadim - ularga varraklaridagi
naqshlarga mos murakkab naqshlar
kashta qilingan edi. Ular boshlariga
sharf o'rashgan va qo'llarini varrak
iplaridan himoya qilish uchun qo'lqop
kiyishlari kerak edi. Varrak
jamoalari asosan erkaklar edi, lekin
yuzlab ayollar va bolalar tadbirni
tomosha qilishga kelgan edi. Muhit
ajoyib edi, atrofimda odamlar
to'xtovsiz bayroq silkitar, nog'ora
urar, karnay chalar va hushtak
chalardi. Shu bilan birga, jamoalar
raqiblarining varraklarini g'azab
bilan yerga tortardi. Shunday ajoyib
tomosha ko'rsatganlari uchun ulardan
hayratlanmay ilojim yo'q edi.

4) Festivalning oxirgi kechasi shahar
markazida sayr qilish va aravalarni
tomosha qilish menga juda yoqdi.
Odamlar ularni yasashga aql bovar
qilmas darajada mehnat sarflagan va
ular chindan go'zal edi. Ertasi kuni
Tokioga jo'nab ketishimni o'ylash
meni xafa qildi, lekin varrak
festivali xotiralari men bilan abadiy
qolishini bilardim.


QALIN SO'ZLAR:

  strength = kuch
  courage = jasorat
  lord = hukmdor, bek
  region = viloyat, mintaqa
  huge = ulkan
  preparations = tayyorgarliklar
  enormous = ulkan
  aim = maqsad
  noticed = payqadim
  elaborate designs = murakkab
    naqshlar
  strings = iplar
  teams = jamoalar
  event = tadbir
  furiously tugging = g'azab bilan
    tortmoqda
  opponents = raqiblar
  stunning show = ajoyib tomosha
  memories = xotiralar


⚠ 'APPARENTLY':

  = aftidan, aytishlaricha.


⚠ 'TO BE AMAZED AT':

  = ...dan hayratda qolmoq.


⚠ 'I COULDN'T WAIT TO':

  = sabrim chidamasdi.


⚠ 'TO TAKE ONE'S EYES OFF':

  = ko'z uzmoq.


⚠ 'TO SHOW OFF':

  = ko'z-ko'z qilmoq, ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'TO KNOCK OUT OF':

  = urib tushirmoq.


⚠ 'TO MATCH':

  = mos kelmoq.


⚠ 'KEPT + -ING':

  = to'xtovsiz ... qilardi.


⚠ 'I COULDN'T HELP + -ING':

  = ...masdan ilojim yo'q edi.


⚠ 'TO PUT ON A SHOW':

  = tomosha ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'AN INCREDIBLE AMOUNT OF':

  = aql bovar qilmas miqdorda.


⚠ 'FOREVER':

  = abadiy.

  NAME/WHEN/WHERE/REASON:

    & sweets

exercises.exampleEn: The Hamamatsu Kite Festival takes place between 3rd and 5th May in Hamamatsu, Japan. People fly kites to bring their children good health, strength and courage.
exercises.exampleUz: Hamamatsu varrak festivali 3-5 may oralig'ida Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahrida o'tkaziladi. Odamlar bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat keltirish uchun varrak uchiradi.
modelAnswers: Before the festival, people make enormous kites, decorate brightly-coloured floats and cook cakes and sweets.

During the festival, the teams have kite battles and try to knock the other teams' kites out of the sky. People wave flags, bang drums, play trumpets and blow whistles. On the last evening, people walk around the city centre and watch the floats.
The writer was very excited and amazed. He felt sad to leave, but he knew the memories would stay with him forever.
modelAnswersUz: Festivaldan oldin odamlar ulkan varraklar yasaydi, yorqin rangli aravalarni bezaydi va tort va shirinliklar pishiradi.

Festival davomida jamoalar varrak janglari o'tkazadi va boshqa jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib tushirishga harakat qiladi. Odamlar bayroq silkitadi, nog'ora uradi, karnay va hushtak chaladi. Oxirgi kechasi odamlar shahar markazida sayr qiladi va aravalarni tomosha qiladi.
Muallif juda hayajonlangan va hayratda edi. U ketishdan xafa bo'ldi, lekin xotiralar u bilan abadiy qolishini bilardi.
